rows.responsibility: OpenAPI operation and runtime route describe the same public API key resource
rows.userInput: Authenticated administrator creates an API key
rows.rateLimit: Not applied on the CRUD page handler
rows.persistence: A team-owned OpenApi document is inserted
rows.allowedDifference: The local async audit and HMAC model are stronger than the reference fire-and-forget behavior.

rows.responsibility: Malformed request bodies are rejected before a key is created
rows.userInput: Request body with a missing or invalid field
rows.rateLimit: Not established by this reference path
rows.allowedDifference: The project uses KNOWLEDGE_VALIDATION_FAILED and a structured Problem response.

rows.responsibility: Missing or invalid API credentials do not authenticate
rows.userInput: Request without a credential or with an unknown credential
rows.persistence: No business object or outbox event
rows.allowedDifference: The local API returns KNOWLEDGE_AUTH_REQUIRED and never echoes key existence.

rows.responsibility: Successful API key creation records a safe audit event
rows.rateLimit: Reference does not expose rate headers
rows.persistence: Exactly one key and one create audit
rows.allowedDifference: Local safeDiff uses keyPrefix and scopes and omits the secret.

rows.responsibility: Dependency failures do not become successful empty responses
rows.userInput: Redis unavailable while processing a rate-limited request
rows.allowedDifference: INTENTIONAL_DIFFERENCE: the project must fail closed and return a stable dependency error.

rows.responsibility: Create returns a usable API key once
rows.userInput: Create key with a name and limits
rows.expectedHttp: Created key returned to the user
rows.rateLimit: Reference CRUD path has no explicit operation bucket
rows.allowedDifference: The project returns one kn_live_ secret only in the create and rotate responses.

rows.responsibility: List masks credentials and never returns a complete key
rows.rateLimit: Reference CRUD path has no explicit operation bucket
rows.allowedDifference: Local list exposes keyPrefix only; reference exposes a masked copyable key.

rows.responsibility: Only the owning member can mutate a key
rows.expectedHttp: Owner succeeds; another member is rejected
rows.authorization: Mongo lookup is constrained by team and member
rows.persistence: Only the selected owner key changes
rows.allowedDifference: Local uses workspace plus knowledge:admin and version CAS.

rows.userInput: Use a key whose expiry is in the past
rows.allowedDifference: Local error is KNOWLEDGE_AUTH_REQUIRED and does not reveal whether the key exists or expired.

rows.responsibility: Tenant identity is derived from the stored key, not caller-controlled headers
rows.userInput: Use a valid key with a forged workspace header
rows.authorization: Stored team must match the request tenant
rows.rateLimit: Bucket cannot be charged to another tenant
rows.allowedDifference: Local additionally enforces HMAC, workspace headers, scopes, and spaceIds.

rows.responsibility: A key without the required capability is rejected
rows.userInput: Use a low-privilege key for a protected action
rows.rateLimit: Trusted key bucket may still be consumed
rows.audit: Reference has no denied action audit
rows.allowedDifference: Local has an explicit five-scope model and must emit or explicitly document a trusted denied audit.

rows.responsibility: Create, update, and delete update persistent state and audit
rows.allowedDifference: Local revokes a versioned rotation chain and returns 204 without a body.

rows.responsibility: Refresh returns only persisted key metadata
rows.userInput: Refresh or reopen the key list
rows.allowedDifference: Local keyPrefix replaces the reference masked-copy value.

rows.responsibility: Rate limit responses expose retry metadata
rows.allowedDifference: Local RateLimit-* and Retry-After are the frozen public contract.

rows.responsibility: Reference stores the complete key and exposes a copyable masked form
rows.expectedHttp: Masked display of a persisted key
rows.audit: Audit must not include raw key
rows.allowedDifference: INTENTIONAL_DIFFERENCE: local persists only HMAC-SHA-256 secretHash and one-time secret output.

rows.responsibility: Key health checks report validity without business mutation
rows.expectedHttp: Validity and usage metadata or invalid-key rejection
rows.allowedDifference: Local has no equivalent standalone health route; compatibility tests use authenticated API access instead.

rows.responsibility: Rotation and overlap are local security extensions
rows.userInput: Rotate a key and use the previous key during overlap
rows.authorization: Only an active owner-controlled key can rotate
rows.audit: Rotation successor and overlap must be audited
rows.allowedDifference: INTENTIONAL_DIFFERENCE: local stores a versioned rotation chain with retireAt.
